title: Everyday Phrases — Brewing Tea at Home
scene_zh: 在家泡茶 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🍵 實用在家泡茶必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Brewing Tea at Home
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用在家泡茶情境對話（從燒水選茶、溫杯投茶、悶泡出湯到續杯收拾，每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Brewing Tea at Home phrase pairs, from boiling water and choosing leaves to steeping, tasting and refills (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels cold this evening.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's make some hot tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, what teas do we have?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə wʌt tiz du wi hæv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More kinds than you think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll get the kettle and water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill it with fresh cold water.
dialogue.zh: 水壺裡接滿新鮮的冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does cold water work better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tastes cleaner, trust me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the kettle looks a bit dirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə ˈkɛtl lʊks ə bɪt ˈdɜrdi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it with a damp cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the outside clean enough now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, now it really shines.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we keep the tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the blue box on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə blu bɑks ɑn ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 在架子那個藍色盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you mean the shelf by the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju min ðə ʃɛlf baɪ ðə ˈwɪndo?/
dialogue.zh: 你是說窗邊那層架子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the one, the top row.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This box is heavier than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɑks ɪz ˈhɛviər ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 這盒子比我想的重多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma always kept extra tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, five little tins inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take them out and smell each one.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðɛm aʊt ənd smɛl itʃ wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This tin smells like soft flowers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's chamomile, for sleeping well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have any black tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the round red tin.
dialogue.zh: 有啊，那個圓圓的紅罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This green one smells fresh and light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs grin wʌn smɛls frɛʃ ənd laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 綠色這罐聞起來清新淡雅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our favorite spring tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does this tall thin tin hold?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðɪs tɔl θɪn tɪn hoʊld?/
dialogue.zh: 這細長罐子裝的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oolong leaves, rolled up tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I didn't know you owned oolong.
dialogue.zh: 我不知道你還有烏龍茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My aunt gave it to me last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ænt geɪv ɪt tə mi læst jɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which tea should we drink now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green tea is light and easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But black tea feels warmer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why not try green first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you like loose leaf tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea bags are quicker for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loose leaves taste much stronger.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, use the green jar today.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，今天就用綠罐的茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the little measuring spoon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the drawer beside the stove.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This drawer is really crowded.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spoon hides behind the sugar.
dialogue.zh: 勺子在糖罐後面躲著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, here's the tiny spoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, now we can start brewing.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，可以開始泡茶了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black tea needs fully boiling water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the kettle must whistle first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green tea likes cooler water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait two minutes after it boils.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does cooler water matter?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too hot makes green tea bitter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I really don't like bitter tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let the water rest a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ðə ˈwɔtər rɛst ə ˈlɪtəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many spoons for the pot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One spoon for every cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So four spoons for four cups?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus one for the pot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a real brewing rule?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma always added one extra spoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take the big glass pot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ðə bɪɡ glæs pɑt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then you can watch the leaves.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɛn ju kæn wɑtʃ ðə livz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watching the leaves dance is fun.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It also shows the changing color.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pot smells like yesterday's tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it with warm water only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No soap for the teapot, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, soap ruins the tea taste.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the lid that fits this pot?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛrz ðə lɪd ðæt fɪts ðɪs pɑt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the cupboard next to the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈkʌbərd nɛkst tə ðə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 去看看冰箱旁邊的櫥櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, behind the plates.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, set it on top of the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /greɪt sɛt ɪt ɑn tɑp ʌv ðə pɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which cups should we set out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wide ones keep tea cooler.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want my favorite blue mug.
dialogue.zh: 我要用我最愛的藍馬克杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds heat much longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the cups clean and dry?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ɔl ðə kʌps klin ənd draɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I dried them after lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's warm the cups with hot water.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts wɔrm ðə kʌps wɪð hɑt ˈwɔtər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's how grandma started every pot.
dialogue.zh: 奶奶泡每壺都先這麼做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour a little hot water in each.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔr ə ˈlɪtəl hɑt ˈwɔtər ɪn itʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swirl it around, then dump it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɜrl ɪt əˈraʊnd ðɛn dʌmp ɪt aʊt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cups feel toasty now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your tea will stay hot longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the pot on the wooden tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə pɑt ɑn ðə ˈwʊdən treɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I add the honey jar too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ æd ðə ˈhʌni dʒɑr tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, some sugar cubes and spoons.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a clean cloth for spills.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You thought of absolutely everything.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea time needs a calm setup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the kettle starting to steam?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, it's rumbling softly now.
dialogue.zh: 你聽，水已經小聲翻滾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost boiling, I can hear it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the jar of leaves ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the lid just clicked, it's boiling.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə lɪd dʒʌst klɪkt ɪts ˈbɔɪlɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你看，蓋子喀噠一聲，水開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now let it cool two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's measure the leaves while we wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈmɛʒər ðə livz hwaɪl wi weɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, four level spoonfuls.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the dry leaves look whole?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, big leaves open slowly and nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bɪɡ livz ˈoʊpən ˈsloʊli ənd ˈnaɪsli./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，大葉子會漂亮地慢慢舒展。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything is ready on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The water rested long enough now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the leaves in the warm pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə livz ɪn ðə wɔrm pɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're giving off a scent already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry heat wakes the tea up first.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ hit weɪks ðə ti ʌp fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I smell grass and a little honey.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ smɛl græs ənd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈhʌni./
dialogue.zh: 我聞到青草和一點蜜香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it's time for the hot water.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪts taɪm fər ðə hɑt ˈwɔtər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pour it gently down the side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, slow and steady?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, don't splash the young leaves.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the water went cloudy at first.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðə ˈwɔtər wɛnt ˈklaʊdi æt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 哦不，水剛開始有點渾濁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, it's clearing up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the leaves are spinning in circles.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə livz ɑr ˈspɪnɪŋ ɪn ˈsɜrkəlz./
dialogue.zh: 現在茶葉在水裡打轉呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the sign of good tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I fill the pot to the brim?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ fil ðə pɑt tə ðə brɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, leave a small space at top.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ liv ə smɔl speɪs æt tɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How full is full enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost full, then stop right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the steam smells like a meadow.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðə stim smɛls laɪk ə ˈmɛdoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green tea always smells like spring.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cover the pot to trap the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌvər ðə pɑt tə træp ðə hit./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, with the lid resting lightly?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs wɪð ðə lɪd ˈrɛstɪŋ ˈlaɪtli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, never press the lid down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tea steeps best when it's cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti stips bɛst wɛn ɪts ˈkoʊzi./
dialogue.zh: 茶在舒服悶著時泡得最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the timer for three minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is three really the perfect number?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too short gives you pale weak tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʃɔrt gɪvz ju peɪl wik ti./
dialogue.zh: 時間太短茶會淡而無味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And too long turns it bitter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So timing is everything with tea.
dialogue.zh: 所以泡茶的關鍵就是時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma never used a timer at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈgrænmɑ ˈnɛvər jʊzd ə ˈtaɪmər æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 奶奶從前根本不用計時器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then how did she know the time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn haʊ dɪd ʃi noʊ ðə taɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She counted slowly to one hundred.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we count together this time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, start at one hundred twenty.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，從一百二十開始數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't peek while the tea is steeping.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt pik hwaɪl ðə ti ɪz ˈstipɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why not? I only want a glance.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt aɪ ˈonli wɔnt ə glæns./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every peek lets the heat escape.
dialogue.zh: 每看一下熱氣就跑掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll keep the lid shut tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl kip ðə lɪd ʃʌt taɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the kettle boil more water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in case we want a second pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪn keɪs wi wɔnt ə ˈsɛkənd pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 好，說不定待會兒還要泡第二壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come, let's wait right here by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm lɛts weɪt raɪt hɪr baɪ ðə ˈwɪndo./
dialogue.zh: 來，我們就在窗邊這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The light shows the tea's true color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt ʃoʊz ðə tiz tru ˈkʌlər./
dialogue.zh: 在光線下才看得準湯色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, most leaves are sinking down.
dialogue.zh: 看，大部分茶葉沉下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few still float on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do floating leaves mean bad tea?
dialogue.zh: 浮著的葉子代表茶不好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they sink once they're soaked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See how the water is turning yellow-green.
dialogue.phonetic: /si haʊ ðə ˈwɔtər ɪz ˈtɜrnɪŋ ˈjɛloʊ grin./
dialogue.zh: 你看水色慢慢變成黃綠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It glows like liquid sunlight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does oolong tea need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes, in much hotter water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's save oolong for a rainy day.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts seɪv ˈulɔŋ fər ə ˈreɪni deɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect plan for a lazy Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 正適合懶洋洋的星期日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, the timer just gave one beep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ðə ˈtaɪmər dʒʌst geɪv wʌn bip./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time to open the sleepy pot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the lid away from your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə lɪd əˈweɪ frʌm jʊr feɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whoa, the steam jumped at me!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, always lift it up slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The color looks exactly ready.
dialogue.zh: 這顏色看來剛好泡好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taste one drop from the spoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not too strong, not too weak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three minutes, just like magic.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma would bless that beautiful color.
dialogue.zh: 奶奶看了那湯色會欣慰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour the tea through the strainer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll rest it on the cup's mouth.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl rɛst ɪt ɑn ðə kʌps maʊθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour in a thin, steady stream.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My stream wobbles but it holds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't shake out the last drops.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why not? They look extra strong.
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？那幾滴看起來最濃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trust me, the last drops are bitter.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst mi ðə læst drɑps ɑr ˈbɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 相信我，最後幾滴全是苦味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing you told me that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did any leaves fall into the cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈɛni livz fɔl ˈɪntə ðə kʌp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two tiny ones, I fished them out.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tu ˈtaɪni wʌnz aɪ fɪʃt ðɛm aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 只有兩小片，我撈出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we leave some tea in the pot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi liv sʌm ti ɪn ðə pɑt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the leaves keep steeping inside.
dialogue.zh: 不，葉子還在壺裡繼續悶著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty the pot in even rounds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So every cup tastes exactly the same?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɛvri kʌp teɪsts ɪɡˈzæktli ðə seɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, tea must be shared fairly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's grandma's golden rule, isn't it?
dialogue.zh: 這就是奶奶的金規矩吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each cup is steaming gently now.
dialogue.zh: 每杯茶都輕輕冒著熱氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It smells so peaceful in here.
dialogue.zh: 這個廚房聞起來好安寧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cup waits for dad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we keep his tea warm?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He always drinks it stone cold.
dialogue.zh: 他每次都等茶涼透才喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then leave his cup out to cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn liv hɪz kʌp aʊt tə kul./
dialogue.zh: 那就讓他的杯子擱著涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loose tea can be messy sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 泡散茶有時弄得亂七八糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse the strainer in the sink now.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ðə ˈstrenər ɪn ðə sɪŋk naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I brew a simple tea bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ bru ə ˈsɪmpəl ti bæɡ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, bags work fine too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drop the bag in the cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pour the water right over it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pɔr ðə ˈwɔtər raɪt ˈovər ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I squeeze the wet bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never squeeze it, that adds bitterness.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes, then lift the bag out.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn lɪft ðə bæɡ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘後就把茶包夾出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it out by its little string.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt aʊt baɪ ɪts ˈlɪtəl strɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tag dangles right over the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tæɡ ˈdæŋgəlz raɪt ˈovər ðə saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我的吊牌垂在杯邊晃呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck it behind the handle neatly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This black mug looks very dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong enough to wake the whole house.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɔŋ ɪˈnʌf tə weɪk ðə hol haʊs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe no black tea at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chamomile is the bedtime choice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save these leaves for a second brew.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðiz livz fər ə ˈsɛkənd bru./
dialogue.zh: 這些茶葉留著泡第二回。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They still smell full of flavor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you take your tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain, just the way it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll stir in a spoon of honey.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl stɜr ɪn ə spun ʌv ˈhʌni./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honey suits green tea nicely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This honey lid is stuck tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run warm water over the edge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That trick worked in one second.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honey always behaves like that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drizzle the honey in a spiral.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks like drawing on tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stir it very slowly now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The honey sinks, then melts away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like some milk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk goes better with black tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I warm the milk first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A splash of cold milk is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə splæʃ ʌv kod mɪlk ɪz faɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll add one to my black tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æd wʌn tə maɪ blæk ti./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pour it close to the rim.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's curling into white clouds right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈkɜrlɪŋ ˈɪntu waɪt klaʊdz raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它在茶裡捲成一朵朵白雲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just like the tea houses do.
dialogue.zh: 跟茶館裡的畫面一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it looks like café tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But ours tastes better, for sure.
dialogue.zh: 不過我們的肯定更好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about sugar in your tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cube only, thank you kindly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That cube is dissolving so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One stir and it's completely done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, did you drop your spoon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's swimming under the tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fish it out with the other spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ ɪt aʊt wɪð ði ˈʌðər spun./
dialogue.zh: 用另一支勺把它撈出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rescued, pardon the little mess.
dialogue.zh: 撈起來了，不好意思灑了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, there's lemon in your cup!
dialogue.zh: 咦，你杯子裡怎麼有檸檬！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sneaked a slice, like a tiny sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ snikt ə slaɪs laɪk ə ˈtaɪni sʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我偷偷加了一片，像顆小太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's taste the very first cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, it's still very hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I took one small sip, oops.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did it burn your tongue a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt bɜrn jʊr tʌŋ ə bɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a tiny pinch of heat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blow on the cup before sipping.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The steam dances when I blow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now this sip feels just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The warm tea slides down slowly.
dialogue.zh: 溫熱的茶湯慢慢滑下喉嚨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hugs me from the inside.
dialogue.zh: 像從裡面輕輕抱了我一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the tea taste sweet to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʊz ðə ti teɪst swit tə ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the honey works so softly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I taste flowers, maybe grass too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the spring inside the leaves.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some teas leave a cool feeling.
dialogue.zh: 有些茶喝完整個人涼涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green tea does, right in the throat.
dialogue.phonetic: /grin ti dʌz raɪt ɪn ðə θroʊt./
dialogue.zh: 綠茶就是，喉嚨特別明顯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my cup a little too bitter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ kʌp ə ˈlɪtəl tu ˈbɪtər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add two drops of hot water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much better, the sharpness is gone.
dialogue.zh: 好多啦，尖銳的苦味不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Almost every pot is fixable.
dialogue.zh: 看見沒？大部分的茶都能救。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I brew it too strong?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ bru ɪt tu strɔŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More hot water, that's the cure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we can rescue any tea.
dialogue.zh: 所以什麼茶都救得回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even grandma nodded at that rule.
dialogue.zh: 連奶奶都同意這條規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrap your hands round the warm cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ræp jʊr hændz raʊnd ðə wɔrm kʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels like a pocket heater.
dialogue.zh: 像個暖暖的隨身小爐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold it while you look outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain began tapping the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect weather for a tea day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kettle can stay busy tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we move to the soft sofa?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑl wi muv tə ðə sɔft ˈsoʊfə?/
dialogue.zh: 我們端去沙發那兒好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, carry the cups on the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈkæri ðə kʌps ɑn ðə treɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the tray is a bit slippery.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl ðə treɪ ɪz ə bɪt ˈslɪpəri./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll walk slow like a penguin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you spill any tea on the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju spɪl ˈɛni ti ɑn ðə weɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only three drops, onto the cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea marks wipe off so easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll dry the wooden tray right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl draɪ ðə ˈwʊdən treɪ raɪt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sofa corner is your favorite.
dialogue.zh: 沙發這個角落是你最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You remembered, that's very sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's watch the steam rise up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It curls and vanishes, every time.
dialogue.zh: 它捲一捲就消失了，每次都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does home tea taste better than shops?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʊz hoʊm ti teɪst ˈbɛtər ðæn ʃɑps?/
dialogue.zh: 家裡的茶比外面的好喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better, and nobody rushes us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A café charges so much more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours is fresher, made with care.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet rules apply at tea time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only small sips and softer talk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No phones for this one hour?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I left mine in the other room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɛft maɪn ɪn ði ˈʌðər rum./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing beats this quiet hour.
dialogue.zh: 沒有比這一刻更享受的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, everything feels slower.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，整個人都慢下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your taste buds awake now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fully awake, thank you very much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More honey for the next round?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's finish this cup first, slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Always sip from the same side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why does the side matter so much?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʊz ðə saɪd ˈmætər soʊ mʌtʃ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grandma said it keeps your luck.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll guard my cup's good side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl gɑrd maɪ kʌps ɡʊd saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那我可得守好我杯子的好面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your blue mug really suits you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It matches my sleepy, happy eyes.
dialogue.zh: 跟我昏昏欲睡的眼睛剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole kitchen smells like tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's soaked right into my sweater.
dialogue.zh: 連我的毛衣都泡入味了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your cup looks nearly empty now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I drank it all without noticing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we start the second pot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The leaves are resting just a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə livz ɑr ˈrɛstɪŋ dʒʌst ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 讓茶葉先休息一小會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same leaves can brew again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? I thought one round was it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli aɪ θɔt wʌn raʊnd wʌz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我以為泡一次就完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green tea gives you three rounds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each round tastes a little lighter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round two likes hotter water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the sleepy leaves wake up?
dialogue.zh: 慵懶的葉子醒過來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour, and steep just two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This cup feels softer, more honeyed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sweetness comes from waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So slow really is better here.
dialogue.zh: 原來慢才是真的有道理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fill your cup one more time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just halfway, let's keep the rest.
dialogue.zh: 倒一半就好，留著慢慢喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we use all the tea tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi juz ɔl ðə ti təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚要把茶全部用完嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, save some leaves for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do wet tea leaves go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma buried them in her garden.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do tea leaves really help the soil?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ti livz ˈrɪli hɛlp ðə sɔɪl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every used leaf fed her flowers.
dialogue.zh: 她泡過的每片葉子都拿去餵了花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The third steep is the palest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tastes like warm flower water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe that light one is best.
dialogue.zh: 說不定最淡的反最好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So gentle, so clean, so calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wool cover is a tea cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʊl ˈkʌvər ɪz ə ti ˈkoʊzi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks exactly like a hat.
dialogue.zh: 它看起來根本就是一頂帽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It really is a knitted pot hat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈrɪli ɪz ə ˈnɪtɪd pɑt hæt./
dialogue.zh: 它真的是織給壺戴的帽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let the pot wear it warmly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ðə pɑt wɛr ɪt ˈwɔrmli./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pot sits snug inside the cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑt sɪts snʌg ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈkoʊzi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little steam escapes from the spout.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl stim ɪˈskeɪps frʌm ðə spaʊt./
dialogue.zh: 壺嘴還溜出一絲絲白氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we top up the kettle?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more round, then bedtime.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kettle hums and starts boiling.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll carry it, you just sit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a wonderful tea helper.
dialogue.zh: 你是超棒的泡茶小助手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want to learn every single step.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɔnt tə lɜrn ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋgəl stɛp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tray has cookie crumbs now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the cookies beside our cups.
dialogue.zh: 是杯子旁那碟餅乾掉的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cookies really do belong with tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even grandma kept a jar of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈgrænmɑ kɛpt ə dʒɑr ʌv ðɛm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you finish your whole cup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down to the very last drop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave the damp grounds for plants.
dialogue.zh: 濕茶渣留給植物當養分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I hate wasting anything.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse the pot with warm water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No soap, I remember the rule.
dialogue.zh: 不用洗潔精，我記得規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pot keeps a tea memory.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So each brew tastes a bit deeper.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ itʃ bru teɪsts ə bɪt ˈdipər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cups go into the dishwasher.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But not your favorite blue mug.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Painted mugs need gentle hand washing.
dialogue.zh: 有彩繪的馬克杯要手洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It dries here on the towel line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt draɪz hɪr ɑn ðə ˈtaʊəl laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 它就晾在這條毛巾繩上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close the tin lids very tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Air makes the leaves go stale.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The green jar waits in the cupboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə grin dʒɑr weɪts ɪn ðə ˈkʌbərd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark and cool keep the flavor fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk ənd kul kip ðə ˈfleɪvər frɛʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the honey jar go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back on the middle shelf, done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for brewing tea with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was my calmest hour today.
dialogue.zh: 這是今天我最放鬆的一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same tea time tomorrow evening?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll set the kettle out early.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl sɛt ðə ˈkɛtl aʊt ˈɜrli./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which tea is next on our list?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ti ɪz nɛkst ɑn ˈaʊər lɪst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The oolong my aunt gave us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should write the steps down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So others can learn our little ritual.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈʌðərz kæn lɜrn ˈaʊər ˈlɪtəl ˈrɪtʃuəl./
dialogue.zh: 讓別人也能學會我們這個小儀式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boil, cool, warm the cups first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Measure, pour, wait, then share.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That list reads like a small poem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt lɪst ridz laɪk ə smɔl ˈpoʊəm./
dialogue.zh: 這步驟讀起來像首小詩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape it beside the blue tea box.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ɪt bəˈsaɪd ðə blu ti bɑks./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grandma would smile at all this.
dialogue.zh: 奶奶看到這一切會微笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'd taste our pot and quietly nod.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd teɪst ˈaʊər pɑt ənd ˈkwaɪətli nɑd./
dialogue.zh: 嚐一口我們的茶，默默點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do your hands feel warmer now?
dialogue.zh: 你的手現在暖起來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tea finished its quiet job.
dialogue.zh: 茶已經悄悄完成任務了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green tea might keep us awake.
dialogue.zh: 綠茶也許會讓我們睡不著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So chamomile owns tonight's last cup.
dialogue.zh: 那今晚最後一杯交給洋甘菊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sleepy tea for a sleepy house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈslipi ti fər ə ˈslipi haʊs./
dialogue.zh: 一壺睏茶，配一屋子的睏意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My eyes agree with that plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window glass is all fogged.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From our tea steam and soft talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ˈaʊər ti stim ənd sɔft tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 都是我們的茶氣和細語。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold rain, warm tea, cozy home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing on earth beats that trio.
dialogue.zh: 人間沒有比這更好的三件套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could drink tea all season.
dialogue.zh: 整個季節我都能這樣喝茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every gray morning, every blue night.
dialogue.zh: 每個灰濛的清晨，每個靜藍的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea time feels like a mini holiday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti taɪm filz laɪk ə ˈmɪni ˈhɑləˌdeɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the kettle is our plane ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd ðə ˈkɛtl ɪz ˈaʊər pleɪn ˈtɪkɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cupboards closed, counters nice and dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kitchen looks peaceful again.
dialogue.zh: 廚房又回復安靜整潔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You did most of the lovely work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd moʊst ʌv ðə ˈlʌvli wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 最美好的那些都是你做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You poured, remember? Team effort.
dialogue.zh: 倒茶的是你呀，我們合作的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's leave the tray till morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we clean it while it's fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wi klin ɪt hwaɪl ɪts frɛʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last shared sip to end it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst ʃɛrd sɪp tə ɛnd ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheers to our little tea party.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheers, we brewed it just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same leaves, same calm, same us.
dialogue.zh: 一樣的茶葉，一樣的從容，一樣是我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to say good night now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, and steep something gentle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dream of green hills tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you dream of warm pots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈonli ɪf ju drim ʌv wɔrm pɑts./
dialogue.zh: 那前提是你得夢見暖壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kettle stands empty and quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits to boil for us again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts tə bɔɪl fər ʌs əˈgɛn./
dialogue.zh: 它在等下一次為我們沸騰。
